description: Where each H5P library shows a correct or incorrect answer (UD-003). `correct`/`incorrect`: the element that gets the visually hidden label (src/feedbackPrefixes.js); pick one whose children the library does not count. `prefixOn`: the element whose ::before shows the visible prefix, when it differs (dist/hvl-feedback-prefixes.css); pick one whose ::before the library does not use and whose size it does not fix. `ownIcon`: the library already draws a ✓/✗ icon for the state, so the visible prefix is the label only.
